column1: go|/ɡoʊ/|v.|去；前往；进行|基础|everyday-actions|go home::回家;go on::继续|We usually go to the market on Saturdays.::我们通常在周六去市场。|Please go on with your story.::请继续讲你的故事。
come|/kʌm/|v.|来；到达；出现|基础|everyday-actions|come back::回来;come from::来自|Can you come to the meeting tomorrow morning?::你明天早上能来开会吗？|This idea did not come to me immediately.::我并不是立刻想到这个主意的。
take|/teɪk/|v.|拿；带；花费；采取|基础|everyday-actions|take a break::休息一下;take action::采取行动|Take an umbrella because it might rain later.::带把伞吧，晚些时候可能会下雨。|It will take a week to repair the road.::修好这条路需要一周。
give|/ɡɪv/|v.|给；给予；提供|基础|everyday-actions|give advice::提供建议;give up::放弃|Could you give me a little more information?::你能再给我一点信息吗？|Do not give up after the first attempt.::不要在第一次尝试后就放弃。

make|/meɪk/|v.|制作；使；作出|基础|everyday-actions|make a decision::作出决定;make sure::确保|We need to make a decision before Friday.::我们需要在周五之前作出决定。|Please make sure that all the windows are closed.::请确保所有窗户都关好了。
get|/ɡet/|v.|得到；到达；变得|基础|everyday-actions|get ready::做好准备;get home::到家|What time do you usually get home from work?::你通常几点下班到家？|The days get shorter as winter approaches.::随着冬天临近，白天变短了。
have|/hæv/|v.; aux.|有；经历；用于完成时|基础|everyday-actions|have a rest::休息;have a look::看一看|Do you have enough time to finish this?::你有足够的时间完成这件事吗？|We have known each other for several years.::我们已经认识好几年了。
do|/duː/|v.; aux.|做；用于疑问或强调|基础|everyday-actions|do homework::做作业;do one's best::尽最大努力|What do you usually do after dinner?::你晚饭后通常做什么？|I will do my best to solve the problem.::我会尽最大努力解决这个问题。
say|/seɪ/|v.|说；表达；写着|基础|say|say hello::问好;say something::说点什么|Please say your name slowly so I can write it.::请慢慢说出你的名字，好让我写下来。|The sign says that the path is closed.::标志上写着这条小路已关闭。
know|/noʊ/|v.|知道；了解；认识|基础|know|know about::了解;get to know::逐渐了解|Do you know where the nearest station is?::你知道最近的车站在哪里吗？|It takes time to get to know a new place.::了解一个新地方需要时间。
want|/wɑːnt/|v.|想要；希望|基础|everyday-actions|want to do::想做;want more::想要更多|I want to learn how to repair my bicycle.::我想学会修理我的自行车。|Do you want some water before we leave?::出发前你想喝点水吗？
need|/niːd/|v.; n.|需要；必要；需求|基础|everyday-actions|need help::需要帮助;in need of::需要|You need a good light to read comfortably.::你需要一盏好灯才能舒适地阅读。|The old building is in need of repair.::这座老建筑需要修缮。
find|/faɪnd/|v.|找到；发现；认为|基础|everyday-actions|find out::查明;find a way::找到办法|I could not find my keys this morning.::今天早上我找不到钥匙了。|We need to find a way to reduce waste.::我们需要找到减少浪费的办法。
leave|/liːv/|v.; n.|离开；留下；假期|基础|everyday-actions|leave home::离家;leave a message::留言|Please leave a message if nobody answers.::如果无人接听，请留言。|The train will leave in ten minutes.::火车将在十分钟后出发。

bring|/brɪŋ/|v.|带来；拿来；造成|基础|everyday-actions|bring back::带回;bring together::使聚在一起|Please bring your notes to our next meeting.::请把笔记带到我们的下次会议上。|The festival will bring people from different communities together.::这个节日将使不同社区的人聚到一起。
keep|/kiːp/|v.|保持；保留；继续|基础|everyday-actions|keep quiet::保持安静;keep a record::保留记录|Keep a record of the books you read.::记录下你读过的书。|Please keep the door open while I carry these boxes.::我搬这些箱子时请把门开着。
put|/pʊt/|v.|放；安置；表达|基础|everyday-actions|put away::收好;put into words::用语言表达|Put your phone away while you are studying.::学习时把手机收起来。|It is hard to put this feeling into words.::这种感受很难用语言表达。
use|/juːz/|v.|使用；利用|基础|use|use a tool::使用工具;use wisely::明智地使用|You can use my computer until yours is repaired.::在你的电脑修好前，你可以用我的。|We should use water more wisely.::我们应该更明智地用水。
eat|/iːt/|v.|吃；进食|基础|everyday-actions|eat out::外出吃饭;eat slowly::慢慢吃|Try to eat a variety of fresh vegetables.::尽量吃各种新鲜蔬菜。|We sometimes eat out when everyone is busy.::大家都忙的时候，我们有时会出去吃饭。

drink|/drɪŋk/|v.; n.|喝；饮料|基础|everyday-actions|drink water::喝水;a hot drink::一杯热饮|Remember to drink water during the long walk.::长时间步行时记得喝水。|Would you like a hot drink after your journey?::旅途结束后你想喝杯热饮吗？
live|/lɪv/|v.|生活；居住；活着|基础|live|live in::住在;live together::一起生活|They live in a small house near the river.::他们住在河边的一栋小房子里。|We need clean air and water to live.::我们需要清洁的空气和水才能生存。
life|/laɪf/|n.|生命；生活；一生|基础|live|daily life::日常生活;all one's life::一生|Music plays an important part in her life.::音乐在她的生活中占有重要位置。|These small changes can improve daily life.::这些小改变可以改善日常生活。
house|/haʊs/|n.|房屋；住宅|基础|everyday-places|a small house::一栋小房子;move house::搬家|Their house has a garden behind it.::他们的房子后面有一个花园。|We plan to move house at the end of summer.::我们计划在夏末搬家。

room|/ruːm/|n.|房间；空间；余地|基础|everyday-places|a quiet room::安静的房间;room for improvement::改进的余地|There is not enough room for another desk.::这里没有足够的空间再放一张书桌。|We booked a room with a view of the sea.::我们预订了一间能看到海的房间。
school|/skuːl/|n.|学校；学派|基础|everyday-places|go to school::上学;after school::放学后|The children walk to school every morning.::孩子们每天早上步行上学。|A new school will open in this area next year.::这一地区明年将开设一所新学校。

book|/bʊk/|n.|书；本子|基础|everyday-places|read a book::读一本书;a history book::一本历史书|This book explains difficult ideas in simple language.::这本书用简单的语言解释复杂的观点。|I borrowed a book about birds from the library.::我从图书馆借了一本关于鸟的书。
person|/ˈpɜːrsən/|n.|人；个人|基础|everyday-places|in person::亲自;one person::一个人|Each person in the group has a different task.::组里的每个人都有不同的任务。|It was nice to finally meet you in person.::终于能亲自见到你，真高兴。

child|/tʃaɪld/|n.|孩子；儿童|基础|everyday-places|an only child::独生子女;a young child::幼儿|Every child should have a safe place to learn.::每个孩子都应该有一个安全的学习场所。|As a child, she spent summers by the sea.::小时候，她常在海边度过夏天。
good|/ɡʊd/|adj.|好的；有益的；擅长的|基础|everyday-places|good at::擅长;good for::对……有益|A short walk can be good for your mood.::短时间散步可以改善你的心情。|She is good at explaining things clearly.::她擅长把事情解释清楚。
new|/nuː/|adj.|新的；初次接触的|基础|everyday-places|a new idea::一个新想法;new to::初次接触|We are trying a new way of organizing our notes.::我们正在尝试一种新的笔记整理方法。|I am new to this city and still get lost.::我刚来这座城市，仍然会迷路。
